elkem-elk-xosl.author: shortskvis
elkem-elk-xosl.text: Samtlige innlegg i går i EU parlamentet mener det haster med beskyttelse av silisium industrien i Europa. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHurFPQ435E Members of the European Parliament debate the future of Europe's silicon metal industry and the risks to strategic supply chains. Speakers warn that European production has fallen sharply amid high energy and regulatory costs and competition from low-priced imports, particularly from China. Silicon metal is used in semiconductors, solar panels, batteries, aluminium alloys, aerospace and defence, making it important to the EU's industrial and strategic autonomy. MEPs call for stronger anti-dumping investigations, safeguards, competitive energy prices and support for European production. The debate also raises concerns about jobs, SMEs, decarbonised manufacturing and the consequences of losing domestic capacity that could take years to rebuild.
